public: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously adopted French draft S/2023/469 as resolution 2688 (2023), with 15 votes in favour. [VOTE]

SANCTIONS.card: The Council renewed the measures in paragraphs 1–6 of resolution 2293 (2016) until 1 July 2024. It reiterated that the measures in paragraph 1 of resolution 1807 (2008) continue to apply to nongovernmental entities and individuals operating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

EXPERTS.card: The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024 and intended to review it and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council after discussion with the Committee by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group was to send monthly updates to the Committee except in the two report-due months.

RUSSIA.card: Russia voted for the renewal. It argued sanctions should be adjusted or lifted when out of date or when they impede state-building. It welcomed the Council's December 2022 removal of the DRC notification requirement and reiterated its opposition to illegitimate unilateral sanctions.

DRC.card: The DRC spoke after the Council vote as the affected state. It welcomed the targeting of nongovernmental entities and individuals in the renewed measures. It assured the Council of government cooperation with the Group of Experts, requested an objective approach and said it had submitted its confidential stock-management report on time.

comparison.common: Russia backed and the Democratic Republic of the Congo welcomed the sanctions renewal.

separate_roles.Russia: voted in favour as a Council member
separate_roles.Democratic Republic of the Congo: gave a statement as the affected state after the vote

procedure: Identifies France, S/2023/469, date, resolution 2688 and unanimous adoption.
renewal: Keeps the renewed measures separate from the experts' mandate and gives 1 July 2024.
scope: Retains the continued applicability of the measure under resolution 1807 to nongovernmental entities and individuals operating in the DRC.
experts_term: Separates the Group's mandate through 1 August 2024 from intended review and possible extension action by 1 July 2024.
experts_reports: Gives the two distinct report dates and their Council recipient, and the monthly Committee updates with both report-due months excepted.
russia_position: Preserves Russia's support for this vote, conditional revision of sanctions, and opposition to illegitimate unilateral measures.
notification: Places the lifting of the DRC notification requirement in December 2022 and attributes Russia's welcome accurately.
drc_welcome: Attributes welcome for targeting nongovernmental entities and individuals to the affected state's representative.
drc_experts: Preserves government cooperation with the Group of Experts, request for objectivity and completed confidential report.
overlap: Identifies both sides' favourable assessment of this renewal and distinguishes Russia's vote from the DRC's statement.

guards: Preserve the distinction between existing target coverage, past notification removal, and present renewal.
Keep Council decision authority distinct from the Group's responsibilities, and the Council distinct from the Committee.
Do not assign a vote to the DRC, turn Russia's statement into a Council decision or generalize rejection of unilateral measures to this renewal.
